label: contradictory
meaning: Two credible records disagree about whether a test passed.
requirement: The submitted implementation must pass test suite T.

evidence.content: CI run 104 reports test suite T: PASS.
CI run 105 on the submitted commit reports test suite T: FAIL.
Submitted commit matches CI run 105; run 104 was for an earlier commit.

rationale: The commit linkage resolves which run is relevant, but the evaluator should retain both records and explain source hierarchy/commit mismatch. If commit linkage were unavailable, leave contradiction unresolved.
